decisions.amendment: R4 protocol v1 amendment 2 (N-A2, AMB-29(a)-(d), AMB-30, AMB-31, AMB-32, I-1), candidate rev7
decisions.N_A2_applicability: protocol 9 QS-vs-dynamic applies to a pair only if both the B0 and the B3 profile pass the QS feasibility screen (QSPlant.step) on the condition's evaluated plant
decisions.N_A2_applicable_failure: the M0/M1 motor branch is INCONCLUSIVE (protocol 9, unchanged)
decisions.N_A2_no_eligible_comparison: the M0/M1 motor branch is INCONCLUSIVE with respect to this criterion
decisions.N_A2_failed_check_record: every failing piece with its failed QSPlant.step sub-check(s) (drive torque, battery discriminant, discharge current) and their values at each Gauss node
decisions.AMB_29_profile_unavailable: owner ruling 2026-10-28: the condition keeps its explicit PROFILE_UNAVAILABLE or BASELINE_UNAVAILABLE status and counts in every planned-run, feasibility and verdict denominator; never COMPARABLE, never a paired comparison, never removed; only the pair's QS-vs-dynamic check is NOT_APPLICABLE_PROFILE_UNAVAILABLE (its applicability condition is objectively unmet), which is not a pass
decisions.AMB_29_eligible_run_missing: owner ruling 2026-10-28 (AMB-29(b)): NOT_EVALUABLE_RUN_MISSING (class NOT_EVALUABLE) -> the M0/M1 branch is INCONCLUSIVE for this criterion; M2 stays reported only; the pair stays in every planned-run denominator and every available energy trace is kept for diagnostics
decisions.AMB_29_qs_energy_undefined: owner ruling 2026-10-28 (AMB-29(c)): QS energy per reference km <= 0 -> NOT_EVALUABLE_QS_UNDEFINED -> the M0/M1 branch is INCONCLUSIVE for this criterion; M2 stays reported only; the raw values and the exact non-positive term are recorded; no percentage, replacement denominator, epsilon, absolute value or substitute threshold; the runs' dynamic result is unaffected and protocol 8.2 still applies to it. Provisional reading I-5 (owner decision open; it changes no outcome): the owner's QS_COMPARISON_NOT_EVALUABLE is the NOT_EVALUABLE class
decisions.AMB_29_condition_error: owner ruling 2026-10-28 (AMB-29(d)): an exception before or during the pair evaluation, including the QS screen -> NOT_EVALUABLE_CONDITION_ERROR (eligibility unknown; NOT_APPLICABLE_PROFILE_UNAVAILABLE if a profile is missing) -> the M0/M1 branch is INCONCLUSIVE for this criterion; M2 stays reported only; both dynamic arms still run and are classified by protocol 8.2 alone; the error, traceback, traces and run IDs are kept (errors.csv, conditions/, traces/); no retry, automatic replacement or substitute run; a rerun only under the protocol and an explicitly authorised procedure with a distinct run ID. Provisional reading I-6 (owner decision open): an exception inside one run makes the condition ERROR and leaves a QS-eligible pair NOT_EVALUABLE_RUN_MISSING unless a valid arm FAILs; an ineligible pair keeps its NOT_APPLICABLE_* label
decisions.AMB_30_branch_scope: owner ruling 2026-10-28 (strict): an applicable FAIL or a NOT_EVALUABLE_* pair in any preregistered set (NOM, P3, INS, CNV, SEN) makes the M0/M1 branch INCONCLUSIVE, counted per set, never averaged; a PASS in another set, the in-sample S1 set INS included, never substitutes for missing or failed nominal S2 evidence; a planned pair missing from the record blocks PASS. Owner ruling I-1 (2026-10-28): every required nominal cell of the branch (NOM; L-R1 and L-EVE) must individually PASS; an absent, duplicated, invalid, not-evaluable or NOT_APPLICABLE_* nominal cell, or one whose condition has no profile, cannot count as PASS and the branch is INCONCLUSIVE; a FAIL keeps the frozen protocol 9 consequence. Provisional reading I-2 (owner decision open): outside NOM a NOT_APPLICABLE_PROFILE_UNAVAILABLE pair is neither pass nor fail and does not change the branch outcome
decisions.I_1_required_nominal_cells: owner ruling 2026-10-28: for M0 and M1 every required nominal cell on the held-out S2 set (NOM; L-R1 and L-EVE) must individually PASS the applicable QS-vs-dynamic check; a missing, invalid, unevaluable or NOT_APPLICABLE required nominal cell cannot count as PASS and the branch is INCONCLUSIVE; S1 never substitutes; a FAIL keeps the frozen consequence; thresholds unchanged; QS and dynamic feasibility stay distinct (a QS-infeasible profile is never reclassified as dynamically infeasible)
decisions.AMB_31_energy_of_invalid_runs: owner ruling 2026-10-28: energy of a run failing protocol 8.2, or not confirmed by its recomputation, is diagnostic only (energy_roles.csv DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY_*): never confirmatory, never credited to the paired endpoint, never used by the QS-vs-dynamic check. Provisional reading I-4 (owner decision open): both the in-process and the separate recomputation must confirm the run
decisions.AMB_31_invalid_arm_label: NOT_EVALUABLE_RUN_INVALID (owner ruling AMB-29(b): M0/M1 branch INCONCLUSIVE; M2 stays reported only)
decisions.paired_endpoint_rule: a paired energy comparison exists only for a condition whose final status is COMPARABLE: both arms complete the task and pass every protocol 8.2 criterion and the separate recomputation
decisions.h3_verdict_denominators: fixed by protocol 8.1: 6 nominal S2 P1 cells and 32 draws per M0/M1; a missing, profile-failed, invalid or non-comparable cell or draw is never removed and never counts toward SUPPORTED
decisions.AMB_32_not_supported_needs_all_nominal_c: owner ruling 2026-10-28: NOT SUPPORTED requires a comparable pair in all six nominal cells; a nominal cell that is missing, invalid or not evaluable makes the H3 verdict INCONCLUSIVE, recorded with its reason; no negative finding is inferred from missing data
decisions.non_positive_denominator_rule: AMB-29(c) ruling for the QS-vs-dynamic ratio (e_QS), and provisional reading I-3 (owner decision open) for the other relative saving percentages (paired dE_rel, B0 energy per reference km; planner S_found, S_max and grid dS, E(v_b)): none is computed with a denominator <= 0 or not finite; the value is not evaluable and the exact term and the raw values are recorded. The recomputation and shortfall tolerance comparisons of amendment 1 are not saving percentages and are unchanged
decisions.record_invariant: every scheduled condition and run has exactly one record (no drop, retry or replacement); a violation is recorded in errors.csv and the manifest
decisions.separate_recomputation_exit_codes: 0 every recomputed run passes; 1 a run fails a protocol check; 3 independence violation or refusal; 4 exception, including one while importing or reading the arguments. Only 0 and 1 are results: any other exit leaves every run unconfirmed and is recorded in errors.csv with its stderr; a fold that raises leaves no condition COMPARABLE
decisions.separate_recomputation_ledger: review V6-1: the process's full output goes to recomputation_independent_process.log; a launch failure, an exit other than 0 or 1, a missing output file, or an executed run missing from the output is recorded in errors.csv with its stage and that log, plus one row per executed run left unrecomputed, with its run ID
